caption: The drawing depicts a figure standing upright, facing slightly to the left. The figure is dressed in a blue shirt with darker blue collar and cuffs, a large red scarf tied around the neck and held by a gold clasp, dark brown pants, and black shoes with gold buckles. The figure also wears a blue hat with a lighter blue brim, and there is a red cloth or pouch hanging from its belt at the right side. The character has light skin, round cheeks, blue eyes, and short brown hair with prominent sideburns and a beard that follows the jawline. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with the artist's name "HILDA OLSON" written at the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Figure "Sailor"
